assignment.fastQualifier: Fast requested; no separate service-tier control was exposed. No claim that Fast was independently set or verified.

outputs.accounting: Receipt bytes, SHA256 and lines are calculated after final serialization and supplied in the final handoff; no recursive self digest is embedded.

readPurposes.inputs: Only the six assigned frozen body-free task-content files were read for implementation and input accounting.
readPurposes.source: Own authored source was read for byte, SHA256 and line accounting.
readPurposes.receipt: Own receipt is read after serialization for final handoff accounting.

retainedExpression.declaration: Exact existing protocol/schema/fields/prose/constants/format/evaluation material; no new grant/novelty claim
details: The four prescribed imports retain their runtime and type ownership.
Public function input/result layout and PersistedToolMediaLayoutEntry union are retained.
Array.isArray, live for-of iteration, original media block references, text strings, data URLs, and case-sensitive data: admission are retained.
The exact missing-store error, text/plain content type, session retention, media toolCallId format, request fields, signal option and object key order are retained.
Existing artifact URI admission remains delegated to isArtifactUri; nullish write skipping and direct receiver-preserving awaited store call are retained.
Per-media createPartId call placement, FilePart and metadata key order, optional-field truthiness, undefined size handling and rereads are retained.
Ordinary JavaScript/TypeScript control-flow idioms and schema literals are required expression; no cosmetic novelty or independent-authority claim is made.

chosenStructure.description: A private admission projector builds the media/layout pair, followed by a public presence-gated sequential artifact and FilePart assembly loop.
chosenStructure.rationale: Keep admission complete before any store/id effect; keep live per-media reads and collaborator calls visible in their required order.
chosenStructure.dataUrlNonNullAssertion: A type-only assertion permits the optional file dataUrl declaration at the admitted write boundary. It performs no runtime validation or caching and preserves the live property read.

manualReview.basis: Only the six provided frozen inputs and the authored output; no source-exposed predecessor or dependency bodies.
coverage: sessionStore is checked first and never invoked or written.
Only nonempty native Arrays are projected; sparse undefined entries still throw at block.type.
Unsupported or non-data media invalidate the entire projection; text-only content returns undefined.
No store or id operations precede full admission; the artifact store is required even for existing artifact URIs.
Existing URI source kind and session ownership are not additionally restricted.
Entries are handled sequentially; write rejection propagates unchanged and prior writes are not rolled back.
The store method retains its receiver and request/options evaluation reads.
FilePart and metadata are constructed in required key/call order with conditional optional own properties.
Canonical input blocks and content are never mutated; the layout preserves original text.
No validator, data decoder, hashing, synthetic URI, global cache, provider call, session transaction, row commit, new permission or authority is introduced.
manualReview.verificationLimit: Manual source reasoning only; no compiler, tests, build, lint, mocks, provider/store calls, OS/user-data execution, repository/history/review exploration or network access.

accessBoundary.enforcement: Instruction-only shared executor; not OS isolation and not an access audit.
accessBoundary.curator: Source-exposed curator supplied the frozen requirements; cooperative freeze occurs before curator body review.
accessBoundary.execution: Shell and Python were used only for scoped input reads, output writing, hashes, line/byte accounting and permission mode accounting.

freezeSemantics: Recorded UTC marks initiation of the final cooperative chmod operation after receipt serialization; final handoff verifies the modes.
